exchanges.title: 12 Global Exchanges

backtest.title: Walk-Forward Backtest
backtest.desc: {days}-day rolling optimisation with market health overlays and dynamic stock selection.

engine.title: Mean-Reversion Engine
engine.desc: Buy at predicted MA − k×σ, sell only at entry + 1%. Aggressive low-k bands for high-frequency entries.

execution.title: Real-Time Execution
execution.desc: 60-second cycle bot with live API integration, intelligent order routing, and position management.

lock.title: Risk Controls
lock.desc: Composite 11-component market health filter (SPY, VIX, TLT, HYG, sectors) gates every trade.

pipeline.title: Execution Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: Six-stage systematic workflow from market regime assessment to trade execution.

items.title: Market Health
items.desc: 11-component composite score (SPY, VIX, TLT, HYG, sectors) classifies regime as GREEN / YELLOW / RED.

items.title: Stock Selection
items.desc: Top 5 per exchange ranked by liquidity × volatility. Re-selected every 10 trading days.

items.title: Model Training
items.desc: Per-horizon grid search over (EMA, lookback, k) optimising for TPD × Sharpe. Re-trained every 15 days.

items.title: Signal Generation
items.desc: Predicted MA ± k×σ bands computed at each slice boundary. BUY when price ≤ lower band.

items.title: Execution
items.desc: API-based order placement with 1% target-only exit. No stop-loss — position held until target hit.

items.title: Risk & Reporting
items.desc: Daily P&L tracking, drawdown monitoring, Sharpe calculation, and automated performance dashboards.
